card.name: Appearance and light in cosmetic descriptions
card.fires_on: Words about how something looks or reflects light, mostly in porcelain veneer and crown text, such as light, translucency, staining and discolored. It also fires on a few visual-creation words like creating and see.

modes.label: Veneer look and light
modes.description: Words describing how porcelain veneers or crowns look, mimic enamel, transmit light or resist stains.
modes.example: it will closely mimic the<< light>> handling characteristics of dental enamel

modes.label: Color and vision words
modes.description: Verbs and word parts about making or seeing visual results, in graphics tutorials or color theory.
modes.example: If all three types of wavelength enter the eye with equal strength, we<< see>> white light.

card.writes: It seems to push toward appearance and look-related wording, and away from words for decoration and aesthetics.
card.plain: It lights up on words about how teeth or images look, especially light, color and translucency in veneer descriptions.
